## Working session summary

All 12 requirements of issue #15 are done, and PR https://github.com/konard/konard.github.io/pull/16 is ready for review. Its description has "Fixes #15", how to reproduce each bug, the tests, and before/after screenshots. 533 tests in 25 files pass, `npm run check` and `npm run build` pass, and CI passes on the latest commit (aa1f10b). Main has no new commits and there are no comments on the issue or the PR.

**What I did since the last update:**
- **Case study:** wrote `docs/case-studies/issue-15/README.md` and listed it in `README.md`. It maps each requirement to the code and the test that checks it, and covers:
```text
  - the root causes: the Skin block jumping between columns, the blue glass panels, the click in the mica sound, and the cut-off page links on phones;
  - every new setting area: the background layers, the corners, the sound and the presets;
  - phone measurements of main and this branch, and the 72-case screen check;
  - a comparison with konard/immortality, the libraries looked at, and the limits.
```

  I checked its claims against the code and corrected a few, such as the rain padding range (0–16 px).
- **CI fix:** CI had started failing on four new moderate security advisories in `fast-uri`, which secretlint pulls in. This is not caused by our code, and main will fail the same check until this PR is merged. `npm audit fix` moved it from 3.1.8 to 3.1.9.
- **Cleanup:** removed the `.gitkeep` from the initial commit and corrected a header comment in `experiments/responsive.mjs` (main fails 8 checks, not 7). I accidentally deleted a tracked log in `ci-logs/` from an earlier issue, then restored it; it was never committed.

**Limits stated in the PR:**
- **First paint on phones is not faster.** It is 80–260 ms later on four pages and 44 ms earlier on `/blog/`. Long tasks are about 45% shorter and the background runs 2–3 times more frames per second. Fixing first paint would mean pre-rendering every page at build time, which is outside this issue.
- **Background cost is overstated.** The phone numbers come from headless Chromium, which draws the universe on the CPU, so its cost looks higher than on a real phone. They still compare main and this branch fairly.
- **Corners are drawn with polygons**, because the CSS `corner-shape` property only works in Chrome and Edge 139+.

CI also shows a line-limit warning for `experiments/collect-registries.cjs` (1354 of 1500 lines); this PR doesn't change that file.
